title: SSP-6.2 — Missing Source Files Report Evidence
summary: record the accepted local Missing Source Files producer, table-only Work rows, exact editor links and bounded verification
content_html:
SSP-6.2 — Missing Source Files Report Evidence

Outcome

SSP-6.2 is complete. The ordinary local Missing Source Files parent document now runs one focused producer on mount and Run/Refresh. It independently constructs every complete canonical Work source path, tests that exact contained path as a regular file, and emits one row per missing Work with Work ID, Work title, and Expected source path. Only Work ID links, using the configured Local Studio origin and exact Work editor route.

SSP-6 is parked before SSP-6.3. Both replacement reports are accepted, but the current Studio Project State route, APIs, activity entry, generator, static Markdown, tests, and image-extension owner remain unchanged until separately approved retirement work.

Delivered Contract

  • docs_missing_source_files_report_v1 reads canonical Works directly and combines project_folder, optional project_subfolder, and project_filename only for complete declarations. It checks each Work path directly and does not import or consume the Uncataloged Files producer, response, represented-directory set, or candidate scan.
  • Each missing regular-file check is constrained below $DOTLINEFORM_PROJECTS_BASE_DIR/projects/. Parent traversal and source-directory or source-file symlinks resolving outside that root stop the report instead of becoming missing rows.
  • The response's report object contains only schema_version and ordered rows; each row contains only work_id, work_title, and expected_source_path. Duplicate Works that name the same absent path retain separate rows. Incomplete source declarations remain omitted, while a directory at an expected filename remains missing because it is not a regular file.
  • The browser shows only Work ID, Work title, and Expected source path plus one Run/Refresh control and ordinary busy, empty, or current-error state. It adds no count, summary, timestamp, generated Markdown, retained presentation, search, sort, copy, Finder action, or mutation control. Work ID uses one fixed narrow track so its row values and both remaining row columns left-align with their headers; Work title and Expected source path split the remaining width equally. Only Work ID is an anchor, using the configured STUDIO_APP_HOST and STUDIO_APP_PORT with /studio/catalogue-work/?work=<five-digit-id>.
  • The local report registry, explicit loader, management service, and POST /docs/missing-source-files are the complete runtime path. The public report registry does not expose this report. The external local dotlineform source document d-20260807-175649-62020b is its separate parent host and generates the expected local by-ID, tree, recent, and search projections.

Verification

  • The focused Missing Source Files producer, report contract, route, accepted Uncataloged Files contracts, and unchanged Project State producer/report-contract suite passed all 52 tests against an isolated writable external workspace. Fixtures prove direct existing and missing paths, optional wa/ink subfolders, incomplete omission, one row per Work for duplicate paths, a directory at the expected filename, filesystem-equivalent Unicode identity, deterministic Work ordering, parent traversal, and directory/file symlink containment.
  • The browser smoke passed the exact three-column DOM, sole Run/Refresh button, Work-ID-only links to the exact Studio editor routes, current-run failure clearing, strict rejection of extra report metadata, and the exact empty-body service request.
  • The temporary live management service returned ok: true with a report containing exactly schema_version and rows. The current real-data result is empty: current nested wa/ink declarations and Work 00894's filesystem-equivalent doll moiré reduced.jpg resolve as regular files. A genuinely absent fixture remains explicit evidence that emptiness is current data rather than a hard-coded expectation.
  • Focused Python compilation, changed JavaScript syntax checks, explicit Python and JavaScript lint, the external dotlineform Docs/search build, generated host inspection, and git diff --check passed with zero Docs warnings.

Independent Review

The bounded diff adds the one independent producer, browser module, route, service dispatch, local registry record, loader, client method, focused tests, smoke, check registration, external parent document, and this delivery evidence. It does not change canonical Catalogue JSON, the Uncataloged Files producer or response, docs_project_state_report_v2, Project State presentation or host data, the old Studio workflow, public report assets, file state, or Catalogue media policy.

Review found no shared audit engine, mode-driven response, recursive or represented-directory discovery, persisted inventory, result metadata, browser local path, Finder activation, Unicode rewriting, inferred Work identity, mutation hook, or early retirement. The implementation stays within the predicted explicit seams and preserves the opposite row grains of the two reports.

The accepted populated-report correction projects the configured Studio origin through the existing local route context and applies one report-specific grid rule. Focused service-config, route-context, report-contract, producer, router-module, and report-module checks pass. A live populated row measured approximately 52px / 244px / 244px; all three row starts matched their header starts with 0px offset, and Work 00635 resolved to http://127.0.0.1:8765/studio/catalogue-work/?work=00635 under the default local binding.

Review Gate

SSP-6.2 is accepted and parked. Begin SSP-6.3 only after explicit retirement approval; that stage must relocate the unrelated image-extension policy before removing the superseded Studio workflow and must leave Docs Viewer Project State intact.
